mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_content_agreement_setting WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE s_content_agreement_setting SET rules_version = #{setting.rulesVersion}, privacy_version = #{setting.privacyVersion}, rules_text = #{setting.rulesText}, privacy_text = #{setting.privacyText}, force_reaccept = #{setting.forceReaccept}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = 1
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_content_agreement_acceptance WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY accepted_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO s_content_agreement_acceptance (user_id, rules_version, privacy_version, accepted_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{rulesVersion}, #{privacyVersion}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
